stem: Draw the graph of the equation \(x + 2y = 4\). Find the area of the triangle formed by the line intersecting the X-axis and the Y-axis.
solution:
For the X-intercept put \(y = 0\): \(x = 4\), giving the point \((4, 0)\). For the Y-intercept put \(x = 0\): \(2y = 4 \Rightarrow y = 2\), giving the point \((0, 2)\). The line meets the axes at \(A(4, 0)\) and \(B(0, 2)\); with the origin \(O(0, 0)\) they form a right triangle.
Area \(= \dfrac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 4 \times 2 = 4\) square units.

stem: A survey was conducted for 180 people in a city. 70 ate pizza, 60 ate burgers and 50 ate chips. Draw a pie diagram for the given information.
solution:
Total people \(= 70 + 60 + 50 = 180\). The central angle for each item \(= \dfrac{\text{value}}{180} \times 360^\circ\).
Pizza: \(\dfrac{70}{180} \times 360^\circ = 140^\circ\).
Burgers: \(\dfrac{60}{180} \times 360^\circ = 120^\circ\).
Chips: \(\dfrac{50}{180} \times 360^\circ = 100^\circ\).
(Total \(= 140^\circ + 120^\circ + 100^\circ = 360^\circ\).) Draw a circle and mark three sectors with these central angles to obtain the required pie diagram.
